# Rack fan and probe cabling

<!-- Generated by make check from part.toml. Edit part.toml, not this file. -->

| | |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `rack-fan-harness` |
| Category | fabricated |

Each fan reaches 500 mm with its own 200 mm lead and the included Noctua 30 cm
extension. Runs longer than that get standard 4-pin fan extensions, one per fan
(no splitters: every fan keeps its own tach line to the controller). The probes
connect to the controller's 1-Wire terminal on their own cables. Lengths are set
once the cabinet and the controller position are known. Route along the cabinet
frame with ties, clear of every rotor, with slack for opening the door if the
intake fans sit on it.
